en.headline: About your cholesterol
body: Cholesterol is a kind of fat in your blood.
Too much can narrow your blood vessels.
Your doctor checks it with a blood test.
Less fried food and being active both help.
en.passage: Eating less fried and fatty food, being active and not smoking help to lower cholesterol.

ms.headline: Tentang kolesterol anda
body: Kolesterol ialah sejenis lemak dalam darah anda.
Terlalu banyak boleh menyempitkan saluran darah anda.
Doktor anda memeriksanya dengan ujian darah.
Kurang makanan bergoreng dan bergerak aktif membantu.
ms.passage: Eating less fried and fatty food, being active and not smoking help to lower cholesterol.

zh.headline: 关于您的胆固醇
body: 胆固醇是血里的一种脂肪。
少吃油炸食物、多活动，都有帮助。
zh.passage: Eating less fried and fatty food, being active and not smoking help to lower cholesterol.
